title: pvTecplotTableReader
body:
## pvTecplotTableReader

Reads a Tecplot ASCII data file (.dat) as a table (vtkTable): one column per variable and one row per data record, with column names taken from a header line. It creates no geometry, so it suits point-wise or line data for plots and table exports. Use pvTecplotReader for Tecplot zone (mesh) data and pvCSVReader for comma-separated tables.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- If column names come out shifted or wrong, adjust Numberofheaderlines, Linewithcolumnnames and Skipcolumnnamefields to match the file's header.
- MaxNumberofRecords limits the rows read for previewing; leave it at the default 0 for the full file.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `TecplotTableReader`. Identity: `sources/TecplotTableReaderCore`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The name of the file to read. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Linewithcolumnnames` | The line that contains the column names. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaxNumberofRecords` | The maximum number of records to read. Use this to preview a file. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Numberofheaderlines` | The number of lines that form the header. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Skipcolumnnamefields` | Number of fields to skip while reading column names. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTecplotTableReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
